what_this_fork_is: Desktop installers, QA/reference tooling, review-build tooling, and its own documentation and release policy for upstream's userscript. It carries no product changes.
next_action: None required for the product. Watch upstream releases; when a newer userscript release lands, repeat the sync and cut the next desktop-v* tag.

refs.product_base_rationale: The release tag points at the version-bump commit, whose dist/chatgpt.user.js is still the 2.36.2 build. The 2.36.3 artifact is generated by the chore: ci build commit immediately after. They differ in dist/chatgpt.user.js and nothing else, so e2dd598 is the only tree that is self-consistent about which userscript v2.36.3 is.

zero_delta_proof.method: Product paths were replaced wholesale from upstream's released tree, not merged hunk by hunk, so no fork hunk can survive inside an auto-merged file.
